calc.title: Investment Calculator
calc.conservativeDesc: Expected return 4–6%/year, low volatility. Ideal for capital preservation. Focus on Bordeaux Premiers Crus with stable, liquid markets.
calc.balancedDesc: Expected return 7–10%/year, medium volatility. Mix of regions: Bordeaux, Burgundy, Tuscany. Good risk/reward balance for a 5–7 year horizon.
calc.aggressiveDesc: Expected return 11–15%/year, high volatility. Emerging regions, great vintages, and collectibles. Best for a 10+ year horizon and high risk tolerance.
calc.disclaimer: Indicative projection based on fine wine historical returns. Does not constitute financial advice. Past performance does not guarantee future results.
calc.tourBudgetDesc: Set the amount you want to invest in fine wine. You can invest from €1,000 to €500,000.
calc.tourHorizonDesc: Fine wine typically appreciates significantly over 5–10 years. Longer horizons reduce risk.
calc.tourRiskDesc: Hover each option to see detailed descriptions, expected returns, and volatility levels.
calc.tourSummaryDesc: The central estimate of your portfolio value at the end of the selected horizon, based on historical returns.
calc.tourChartDesc: The shaded area shows the range of likely outcomes. The band widens over time as uncertainty increases.
